::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/credit_units/{unit}/archive"}
#docs
Grants that use it stay as they are.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `unit` | `string` | **yes** | The credit unit's id: the slug you chose. |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `credit_unit`. One of `credit_unit`. |
| `id` | `string` | The slug id. Fixed after create. |
| `name` | `string` | Singular, for example `credit`. |
| `plural_name` | `string` | For example `credits`. |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `minor_per_unit` | `string` | Minor units of `currency` per 1 unit, as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places. For "1 credit = USD 0.01" send `"1"`. |
| `decimals` | `integer` | 0 to 4. Grant amounts are whole numbers of 10^-decimals units. |
| `locked` | `boolean` | True after the first grant in this unit. |
| `locked_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The locked time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `status` | `string` | The credit unit's status. One of `active`, `archived`. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit unit was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit unit was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `resource_version` | `integer` | Send as `expected_version` to refuse a stale update. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The archived unit. |
| `404` | No such credit unit. |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/credit_units/seat/archive" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```
